campaign.title: M1 D=1 large-defect root-dispersion gate

resource_policy.literature_policy: Audit current primary incomplete quadratic Gauss, Salie or Kloosterman, quadratic-congruence-root large-sieve, modular-parabola, sparse-root, and quotient-character sources only against the exact k-j object. Record theorem numbers, modulus and gcd hypotheses, interval lengths, coefficient class, averaging, weights, endpoints, complete and incomplete terms, exceptional cases, and every translated R-M-J-K-N power.

frozen_target.question: For the exact D=d=L=1 direct large-defect wave below M^449 asymp R^780, can the nearest-integer root coordinate j=k^2-Nn, its sparse quadratic congruence, quotient chi_4 character, and a cancellation-preserving completion or dispersion prove the X^epsilon target or a strict owner-complete range; if not, what is the first exact Gauss, root-spacing, completion, quotient-profile, diagonal, endpoint, source, or power obstruction?
frozen_target.reference_formula: Let R=X^(1/4), N=floor(X), J=M^(3/4), 1<<M<=R^2, k(n)=floor(sqrt(Nn)+1/2), and Q_U=sum_(n>0 odd,|k(n)^2-Nn|>J)chi_4(n)n^(-3/4)A_U(n)e(sqrt(Nn)). With j=k^2-Nn, the exact cell is -k<=j<=k-1, n=(k^2-j)/N is a positive odd quotient, and e(sqrt(Nn))=e(-j/(k+sqrt(k^2-j))). The exact arithmetic selector is 1_(N|t)chi_4(t/N)=(-i/(2N))sum_(h mod 4N,h odd)chi_4(h)e(ht/(4N)).
quantities: Retain the literal actual profile, zero extension, support components, endpoints, transitions, strict large-defect mask, nearest-integer convention, and external B_(1,U)(1) seam.
Prove and use the exact cell -k<=j<=k-1, not an asymptotic replacement, and keep both signs and every dyadic defect range J<|j|<=k.
Record k asymp sqrt(NM), its incomplete interval length, 2k<N only with fixed-dilate constants and sufficiently large X, and the exact injectivity or multiplicity of n to k.
Keep N|(k^2-j), odd quotient, chi_4((k^2-j)/N), and every modulo 2N and 4N parity condition. Do not assume N odd or squarefree.
If Fourier completion is used, retain every odd h mod 4N, its chi_4 sign, all gcd(h,4N) factors, two-adic cases, complete Gauss terms, incomplete remainders, and outer h and j summations.
The exact phase is e(-j/(k+sqrt(k^2-j))); no Taylor truncation is licensed uniformly when |j| is comparable to k without a proved error owner.
Round-152 exact and small-defect sectors may be removed at scalar level before Cauchy but never by deleting a mask inside a correlation.
Raw pair count, actual M^(-3/4) weighted capacity, and the signed chi_4 mass are separate objects.
A bound for one root, one h, one j-block, or one complete Gauss sum is not a complete estimate until every outer variable, endpoint, profile, and imprimitive factor is restored.
The D>1 recovery fibre, L>1 rows, growing-M generic t=1 sector, every original t>=2 layer, the Round-138 cross owner, and every M2 or downstream interface remain separate.

Classify all diagonals, exact phase or congruence collisions, near collisions, imprimitive gcd strata, two-adic cases, completion boundaries, and positive versus negative defect branches before claiming a gain.

Prove |Q_U|<<X^epsilon, isolate a strict owner-complete range, or establish the first exact completion, Gauss, root-spacing, quotient-profile, source-hypothesis, endpoint, diagonal, or power obstruction.
Source-audit every imported quadratic Gauss, Salie/Kloosterman, modular-root, sparse-root, square-modulus large-sieve, or quotient-character theorem against the literal expanded sum.
Independently review the exact coordinate, modulo-4N normalization, every R-M-J-K-N-h power, mask order, endpoint, and downstream scope.
Close under exactly one label: large_defect_root_dispersion_target, strict_large_defect_root_range, or large_defect_root_dispersion_no_go.

review_seams.requirement: The exact direct large-defect wave retains chi_4, actual profile, zero extension, strict mask, endpoints, B_(1,U)(1), and every prior owner exclusion in a lawful order.
No ties, both cell endpoints, the converse, positivity, quotient parity, support length, injectivity, and unique congruence representative are exact for all N.
The modulo-4N normalization, sign, odd h family, two-adic cases, imprimitive gcd factors, complete Gauss evaluations, and incomplete remainders are all retained.
Every j-sign and dyadic range, h and k outer sum, Cauchy diagonal, collision, near collision, completion boundary, actual weight, and R-M-J-K-N-h power is priced.
Every external theorem matches the literal coefficient, quadratic or root phase, modulus, interval, averaging, gcd, actual profile, cell, mask, endpoint, and uniformity hypotheses.
Root counts, Gauss bounds, capacities, and theorem RHS terms are not signed lower bounds, and no broader owner or exponent is promoted without proof.
